title: Dynamic load via syscall.Exec (go) — review required
description: The go call syscall.Exec loads plugins, replaces the process image, or marks strings as safe HTML. Untrusted input becomes code or script. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms trust or replaces it with exec with an args list.
remediation: Replace with exec with an args list.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any syscall.Exec call matches.
